Public API redesign analysis: Property.View adoption vs labeled-method renames vs status quo. Outcome: Option C (labeled methods) shipped 2026-05-08.
Prior-art survey: type theory, FP languages, Swift stdlib/tuples, SE proposals, future directions. Long-lived reference for future Pair design questions and deferred Either work.
Adoption of Equation.Protocol / Hash.Protocol / Comparison.Protocol fork protocols + stdlib Comparable. Forward-compatible with SE-0499 typealias path.

Forward directions: 14 candidates analyzed across category-theory totality (assocL/assocR, distributivity, sequence/traverse, bifold, bizip, These, Tagged-Pair, n-ary Product bridge) and Swift Evolution forward-pass (SE-0470/0494/0499/0503/0507/0518/0530, BitwiseCopyable, InlineArray/Span interop). Verdicts: 5 ADOPT (assocL/assocR, sequence over Optional/Result/Either, SE-0499 cleanup, BitwiseCopyable, InlineArray interop tests), 6 DEFER, 8 REJECT, 1 DONE. Top 3: A4 sequence, A1 assocL/assocR, B5+B6 BitwiseCopyable + InlineArray. Cross-package implications: A2 distributivity and A4 Either variant share a Pair↔Either bridge-package decision needing user input.
